title: callianthemum rutifolium
intro: Callianthemum rutifolium, commonly known as Western sky lupine or Sierra anemone, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the family Ranunculaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Callianthemum rutifolium include its use as a diuretic and a treatment for respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
